(Japanese: '''勝者と敗者…''' ''The Winner and The Loser...'') is the 29th chapter of the [[Pokémon RéBURST]] manga.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}
== Major events ==
* [[Hariru]] is defeated by [[Ryouga]].
* Ryouga collapses from losing all of his strength and Hariru takes his 1 medal and leaves.
* Hariru finds [[Carola]] injured after being defeated by [[Fraud]] and swears revenge on him.
* {{OBP|Shin|RéBURST}} and Fraud make it to the next round.
* Rabine attempts to take Ryouga's remaining medals but he wakes up before he can take them.
* Believing that he lost to Hariru, Ryouga accidentally knocks out Rabine in anger and takes his medal.
